interaction_target: the person whose host this is
borrowed: nothing. There is no donor for this one: the market has settings pages, and a settings page is not what this is. The dials here are the estate's own laws, so the surface is the estate's own.
shape: one page whose entire state is the query string, so a shape is a URL somebody else can open
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — offers the session that would fill it
empty (200, no records) — an empty projection
failed (other) — nothing rendered rather than stale or invented
extent_exceeds_authored (409) — extent narrows; it never grants an action layer
actions: offered, never submitted, and only where the organ reports carries_action_layer. Observing a source is the one effect this surface issues, and the estate's own ForeignTwin owner performs it.

dials.mode: section 76 — six modes over four territories; a mode's verbs are a subset of its territory's
dials.extent: section 68 — the density dial. Served by the address organ, which caps the records and withholds the effect class itself
dials.keep: section 61 — the retention lattice as an admission floor. Promotion up it is never automatic
dials.shown: which patterns are composed at all

forbidden_inference: shaping a surface -> authority over what it reads
a narrowed extent -> a shorter set; the withheld count is reported
an observed foreign edge -> a connection to that host, or a claim about it
a mode -> a separate product; the modes are projections of one Matrix
a retention floor -> those tiers being empty
requires_authority: observing carries the `self` session scope; every read on this page answers without one, so a refusal here is a refusal and not an absent subject

lineage.note: authored against sections 11, 12, 60, 61, 68 and 76 of the mature-estate document rather than vendored from a reference UI
